verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint that reaches multiple AI providers through a single URL. Developers switch providers by changing only the model and apiKey parameters, and the docs list Workers AI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Replicate and more as supported. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that cross-provider calls behave consistently, and documentation of provider-specific feature gaps in the unified schema.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call many model providers through one consistent API

citations.quote: Cloudflare's AI Gateway offers an OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint, enabling integration with multiple AI providers using a single URL.
Switch providers by changing the \`model\` and \`apiKey\` parameters.
Workers AI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenAI, Replicate, and more work with AI Gateway.
access every provider through a single API
